items.title: i wired my toilet to a Raspberry Pi
items.summary:

My toilet officially has an IP address. Every time my editors flush, all of our computers drop off the NAS and even the internet kind of hiccups, so I put a float switch in the toilet tank and wired it to an old Raspberry Pi. Now I know exactly when that toilet flushes, down to the millisecond, and my whole team gets a Slack alert. It took a Lego, a few tries, a few zip ties and way too much hand washing. That's just good IT work.
